facts.fact: Cameroon's national climate change observatory ONACC launched on 2026-01-14 a climate-risk monitoring platform for drought and flood early warning, built on weather observation, satellite imagery and field data, which it says serves agriculture among other sectors.
facts.system: ONACC plateforme numérique de suivi des risques climatiques

systems.system: ONACC plateforme numérique de suivi des risques climatiques

CMR.note: A climate platform, not AI in general administration.

facts.fact: ONACC says its public climate-risk platform, launched 2026-01-14, uses a neural-network model to predict the evolution of climate parameters and anticipate hazards, and that simulations covering all of 2025 were run for Douala and Maroua.
facts.system: ONACC plateforme numérique de suivi des risques climatiques

facts.fact: ONACC says its climate platform, developed locally with researchers from the Ecole Nationale Supérieure Polytechnique de Yaoundé, integrates a locally built neural-network model, and was launched on 2026-01-14.
facts.system: ONACC plateforme numérique de suivi des risques climatiques

CMR.note: ONACC is a climate observatory, not named as the national meteorological service.
